Japan's (JPN) **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** for the period beginning 2026-05-01. It ranks **32nd of 121** countries.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. The global average is 1.0, so Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population alone would predict.

Compared with the global average:
- **Work, personal and coursework use:** 47% / 47% / 6% in Japan, against 43% / 40% / 16% globally.
- **Augmentation vs. automation:** 53% / 47% in Japan, against 51% / 49% globally.

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index

- Compare Japan with South Korea.
